documentTitle: Community Behavioral Health Supports (CBHS) — Note / Incident Report

entries.behaviorObserved: William stopped at every gate, touching the metal and humming. He attempted to enter a small kiosk by pulling the door handle repeatedly.
entries.interventionApplied: I held his hand, redirected him gently, and changed his diaper afterward.

entries.behaviorObserved: At the supermarket, he touched packaged food, tried to open a cereal box, removed his shirt once, and attempted to walk toward the exit with bread.
entries.interventionApplied: I kept his shirt on, redirected him from exits, and held his hand throughout.

entries.behaviorObserved: He paced near the hallway, tapping the wall corners and humming softly.
entries.interventionApplied: I guided him to a quieter area and reduced stimulation.

entries.behaviorObserved: He ran to the kitchen repeatedly, opening the fridge and smelling food items without eating.
entries.interventionApplied: I offered safe snacks and supervised closely.

entries.behaviorObserved: He locked himself in the bathroom and sat fully clothed without voiding.
entries.interventionApplied: I unlocked the door and redirected him calmly.

entries.behaviorObserved: Restless sleep with occasional murmuring.
entries.interventionApplied: I monitored quietly and ensured comfort.

entries.behaviorObserved: He pressed his face against shop windows, humming at his reflection. He attempted to enter a barber shop by pulling the door repeatedly.
entries.interventionApplied: I redirected him gently and held his hand throughout.

entries.behaviorObserved: He sat on the living room floor sliding a cup back and forth, humming with each movement.
entries.interventionApplied: I offered a soft sensory item and redirected him.

entries.behaviorObserved: He removed his shirt and placed it inside the kitchen drawer.
entries.interventionApplied: I dressed him and secured the drawer.

entries.behaviorObserved: He wandered into the hallway sliding his hands along the floor tiles, tracing grout lines.
entries.interventionApplied: I stayed close and redirected him to a padded chair.

entries.behaviorObserved: He locked himself in the bathroom and ran the tap continuously.
entries.interventionApplied: I unlocked the door, turned off the tap, and supervised closely.

entries.behaviorObserved: He attempted to head outside barefoot while humming.
